title: Redfin Estimate: How accurate is it
key_point: 500+ data points; median error 1.89% on-market vs 7.38% off-market; covers ~92M homes; not an appraisal.

title: 2025 Home Buyers and Sellers Generational Trends
key_point: Neighbourhood quality 59%, friends/family 45%, affordability 36%, job 34%, schools 16%, walkability 21%, public transport 6%.

title: Key Takeaways from NAR's 2025 Profile of Home Buyers and Sellers
key_point: First-time buyers 21% (record low), median buyer age 59, 88% used agent, 10-week search, 4 weeks on market, 99% of list.

title: Inside the 2025 Home Buyer & Seller Trends
key_point: 2025 Profile neighbourhood factors: quality 59%, friends/family 47%, affordability 35%; FSBO 5% all-time low.

title: When did location, location, location stop meaning close to work?
key_point: Job proximity as neighbourhood factor fell from 52% (2014) to 31% (2025), attributed to older buyers rather than remote work.

title: The New URAR Rollout Has Begun
key_point: Dynamic data-driven URAR replaces legacy forms; GSEs stop accepting old format Nov 2026; appraisers fear data-entry shift.

title: Does Human-Algorithm Feedback Loop Lead to Error Propagation? Evidence from Zillow's Zestimate
key_point: 1% higher Zestimate raises list price 0.733% and sale price 0.081%; feedback loop disturbances fade; Austin lacks sold prices.

title: Appraising Home Purchase Appraisals
publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia (Calem, Lambie-Hanson, Nakamura)
key_point: ~30% of purchase appraisals exactly equal contract price, <10% below; clustering at LTV notches; AVMs more informative for default.

title: Unpriced Climate Risk and the Potential Consequences of Overvaluation in US Housing Markets
publisher: Nature Climate Change via RFF (Gourevitch et al.)
key_point: Flood-exposed US homes overvalued $121-237bn; concentrated in coastal counties without flood disclosure laws; low-income owners most exposed.

title: Unpriced Climate Risk and Overvaluation in US Housing Markets (Briefing Note 479)
key_point: Summarises Gourevitch: First Street model, Florida overvalued >$50bn, 14.6M properties at 1%+ annual flood risk.

title: Risk Disclosure and Home Prices: Evidence from California Wildfire Hazard Zones
publisher: Resources for the Future (Ma, Walls, Wibbenmeyer, Lennon)
key_point: High fire-hazard homes with mandatory disclosure sell ~4.3% less (moderate 2.6%); larger in SoCal and after 2020-21 fires.

title: Wildfires and Real Estate Values in California
publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco (Bengali, Nechio, Stewart)
key_point: Fire distance irrelevant to CA values 2008-17, ~2% premium 2018-21; insurance/FAIR Plan access does not offset the discount.

title: How Much is a Point of Walk Score Worth?
key_point: One Walk Score point = $3,250 / 0.9% avg across 14 metros; nonlinear ($181 at 19-20, ~$7,000 at 79-80); SF 0.42%, Seattle 0.96%.

title: Walk Score Methodology
key_point: Max points for amenities within 5-minute walk, decay to 30 minutes, block length/intersection penalties; Transit Score sums route usefulness.

title: GreatSchools Ratings Methodology
key_point: 1-10 rating from student progress, test scores, college readiness and equity, relative within state; public and charter only.

title: Why are Zestimates/Redfin estimates way off from sold prices
key_point: Bay Area AVMs $50-100k above sold prices; users call them lagging marketing tools blind to condition; reliable within ~10% at best.

title: HOA fees in SF
key_point: SF condo HOA $500+/month, high-rises ~$1k; special assessments in thousands; read HOA budget; split on condo vs house.

title: SFH suggestions: South Bay vs East Bay
key_point: $2M buyer filters by school quality, <30-minute commute, backyard; Pleasanton/San Ramon favoured, Dublin density concerns.

title: Zillow estimation is too wrong in Austin
key_point: Austin home: Zillow $460k vs Redfin $600k vs Black Knight $530k; Texas non-disclosure blamed; use comps instead.

title: Better-informed sellers are raising the stakes for CMAs
key_point: 2,165-agent survey: comps fell to 3.7-8.7; pricing top objection 63.7%; 83.2% likely to use AI CMA tools.

title: Why did Zillow remove climate data from its home listings?
key_point: CRMLS questioned First Street accuracy; 14-16% of CA agents saw sales fail over insurance; Redfin keeps climate scores.

title: Zillow drops climate risk scores after agents complained of lost sales
key_point: Scores added Sep 2024, removed from 1M+ listings Nov 2025; First Street flagged >90% of LA-fire-burned homes as severe/extreme.

title: Compass, Zillow and private listings: 2025 rewind
key_point: NAR MLOS delayed marketing; Zillow Listing Access Standards from June 30 2025; Compass sued Zillow and Seattle's NWMLS.

title: California's FAIR Plan carries growing load as insurers retreat beyond wildfire zones
key_point: FAIR Plan grew 43% Sep 2024-Dec 2025; 14% of policies and 28% of exposure now in urban lower-risk areas.

title: Miami condos: What every resident/buyer needs to know
key_point: 30-year (25 coastal) recertification; SIRS reserves raise fees and assessments; county loans $19.9M to 734 owners.

title: How Accurate Is a Zestimate? What Naperville Sellers Should Trust
key_point: Zillow Aug 2026: 1.78% on-market, 7.20% off-market median error; on-market estimates ingest list price; blind to condition.

title: Zillow Estimates Guide: What It Is & How Accurate It Is
key_point: March 2025: 1.94% on-market, 7.06% off-market; 82% within 5%, 95% within 10%, 99% within 20%.

title: How Accurate is the Redfin Estimate?
key_point: SSRS study of 5,661 sales: Redfin 2.06% vs Zillow 5.95% vs Homes.com 10.26% median error; Redfin-commissioned.

title: How Reliable Are Zillow Home Values in Austin?
key_point: Texas non-disclosure means portals lack sold prices; AVMs rely on list prices and tax data; agents use MLS CMAs.

title: Most agents aren't including Zestimates, iBuyer info in CMAs
key_point: Snippet: 91% of agents trust MLS data most; 84% think Zestimate inaccurate; 65% seldom include it in CMAs.

title: The Future is Now: Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac Announce UAD 3.6 Implementation Timeline
key_point: Snippet: limited production Sep 8 2025, broad Jan 26 2026, mandatory Nov 2 2026; interior/exterior and room-level condition ratings.

title: Zestimate
key_point: Official Zestimate methodology and accuracy page; blocked (403), figures taken from secondary sources.
